## Verdict
accepted

## Concerns
- None. The exact artifact covers every support degree \(4,\ldots,36\), includes complete \(h_1,\ldots,h_4\) Pieri rows and matrices, and reports Smith data yielding \(J_{2,7}/A_+J_{2,7}\cong\mathbb Z^6\) under the stated accepted presentation assumptions. The report explicitly limits the conclusion to this bounded case.
